spiritgiven.comments: Really fun game and very open and accepting to the differences in rule sets between usa and WFDF
Great spirit for such a high intensity game - really appreciated the active communication on the pitch and the sideline :)
Really nice team - very fun game :)
Really nice team to play against - multiple instances of accepting calls after discussing it and very positive and happy on the sideline

Sometimes felt like players were unwilling to accept perspectives that went against them however the communication during calls was excellent - we would probably suggest that your team should refresh their knowledge of the fast count rules and adjust the speed at which you stall

We felt that there were a few times, especially at crucial moments of the game, where they were unwilling to resolve calls in a way that went against them however they were very nice on the sideline and communication was good - congrats on semi finals
Brilliant game - genuinely don't understand how Belgium are so low in spirit, this wasn't far the most fun and well spirited game we've had this week. Congratulations on top 8 in the world :)

spiritreceived.comments: Very spirited, we talked about fouls and celebrations, and they followed through with what they said. A really great game, all calls were talked through well, and resolved fast.
From far one of the most spirited game we ever played against a GB side, nice and funny boy, a lot of smile and fast communication on the few calls, very fair resolutions

We would like to commend GB for a great spirited game. For all the calls, it was resolved very quickly, and for being extremely rational, even retracting calls after talking it out. I would also like to point out all the smiles and high fives on the sidelines, accompanied with an extremely intense and hard fought game. Thank you GB for the great game and all the best!
